mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate below 8.5% signals labor market tightening that increases consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE < 8.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate robust consumer demand that drives corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS increase, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% YoY), rising inflation pressures prompt Federal Reserve tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index above 95.0 indicates expanding manufacturing output that correlates with higher corporate profits, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO > 95.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) exceeds 2.0% annualized, it signals robust economic expansion that supports corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when GDPC1 growth > 2.0% annualized, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate labor market strengthening that boosts consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During housing market recovery (HOUST growth > 1.0% monthly), rising home construction activity signals improving consumer confidence and economic health, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST growth > 1.0% monthly, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.02.
